hotel_name: Hotel Ashiyana Elite, Near Golf Course Road

positive_snippets: My husband and I lodged in this hotel for a month and their services were awesome,  All their staff were  nice and also serviceable. Above all we had the opportunity to celebrate their day of colours(Holi) they made provision for music and colours for the guests to celebrate, it was so beautiful a celebration  on March 4, 2026.  We really enjoyed  our peace and vacation.
The staff were incredibly polite, helpful, and professional. Their positive attitude and excellent service made my stay comfortable and memorable. Highly recommended!
It is a great experience to stay here. It is very quite and clean place for staying. The food was amazing which we had tried.
